code:
git switch main
git merge feature-login

# main:      A---B---C---------M
#                     \        /
# feature:              D---E--
caption: A new merge commit (M) ties both tips together — nothing from either history is rewritten.

code:
git switch feature-login
git rebase main

# main:      A---B---C
#                      \
# feature:               D'---E'
caption: D and E are replayed as new commits (D', E') on top of main — same changes, new hashes.
